subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm: swap: drop dropbehind swap cache folios on writeback completion

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of drop-behind swap cache folios by freeing them immediately after writeback completion, rather than leaving them for reclaim to find later. This is done by adding two new functions: `swap_writeback_dropbehind_folio` and `swap_dropbehind_free_one_folio`, which are called when a synchronous-IO swap completes or an asynchronous block device completes writeback. The patch also updates the `remove_mapping` function to take additional parameters for tracking reclaim status and target memory cgroup. This change is necessary because synchronous-IO swaps can complete in the calling context, allowing the folio to be freed immediately, while asynchronous block devices require deferring the work to a workqueue that runs after writeback completion.
